note: Declared entity identity for the extraction write path (#537). Ported from OaK's task kernel (arXiv 2608.22974): the schema decides what the graph is allowed to contain, the graph supplies the evidence. This file is HUMAN-EDITED and extractor-READ-ONLY — the nightly jobs that have burned this repo before must not write it. The gate that reads it lives in app/entity_naming.py (gate_entity_name / register_schema_keys) and is wired into scripts/memory/next-gen-memory/fact_extractor.py. A declared alias attaches future extractions to the canonical row; it does NOT migrate facts already filed under the variant, which is read-side work owned by #400/#512. Declare an alias only when the two names are unambiguously the same thing: a wrong alias silently redirects facts forever, so ambiguous pairs (Backlog vs Lloyd Backlog) are deliberately left undeclared and stay separate entities.
types_note: Superset of app.entity_kind.KINDS plus the two spellings `entities.kind` already carries in kg.sqlite (`pipeline`, `subsystem`). Deliberately not a second taxonomy: a declared type is written to entities.kind.
